name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion` support. It meets WCAG AAA for users who rely on high-contrast focus indicators while remaining visible on mobile and touch devices. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on desktop, but this improves clarity without sacrificing usability.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 7:1 fails users who need *both* high contrast *and* reduced motion—thicker rings trigger discomfort for some. A 6px ring at 4.5:1 covers more cases but risks missing AAA contrast for some users. Test both with real screen-reader users on mobile and desktop; the one with fewer complaints wins.
